title: Mountain top mansion.
content: Just stumbled across this sub for the first time and I'm very interested, I know that I have a kind of dream hub where certain types of places are repeated and I find the posts here intriguing as it seems like many people are having similar dream experiences. My personal belief is that it is kind of just an amalgamization of various experiences and fantasies that we have had and that our dreams do not actually overlap, but who really knows. There is one place I visit pretty frequently in my dreams and I just started a few months ago or possibly last year. It's hard to keep track of when things happen in dream space compared to the real world. In my dreams, there is a really long stretch of highway between places which I frequently find myself traveling between. On this highway, at one point there is a very large mountain in the middle of a desert like area. It's not a full-blown desert as there is occasionally some greenery but it's mostly just the highway and then you come across this mountain. You take some kind of lift to the top of the mountain, where there is a large property that is fenced in around the sides of the top, and also a huge mansion. I've had all kinds of dreams about this place, and sometimes they just kind of flow into other areas and I will be somewhere else without really having traveled, so I'm not entirely sure how it works or if it's just, whatever you think of, there you are. But I know that I have been stuck on this property before in some of my dreams and that it seems to be a place where very shady things are going on. It's run by rich people or some kind of secret society. I know I have had to lie about my identity before while there. Anyway, I wish I could remember more specifics, but things do tend to just fly out of my head after I wake up a lot. I also have a mall I visit like every night, but there's an attached movie theatre that turns into an airport, and I fly to "the city" which is basically like a weird mash up of everywhere I have ever lived or traveled to. I don't really place too much significance on this and I, like I said, don't think that our dream spaces really overlap. But it's nice to see that there are people with a similar dreamscape because the people I have asked about this in real life do not really have dreams this way, so I was wondering if I was unique and it is good to see that I am not.
